lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 今天很冷。要穿很多衣服。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng. Yào chuān hěn duō yīfu.
lines.english: Today is very cold. You need to wear lots of clothes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Bù xiàyǔ. Míngtiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
lines.english: No rain. Tomorrow's weather is very nice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 太好了！我喜欢不冷的天气。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ xǐhuan bù lěng de tiānqì.
